recalls.summary: NISSAN IS RECALLING CERTAIN VEHICLES THAT WERE EQUIPPED WITH A GARMIN NUVI MODEL 750 NAVIGATION SYSTEM.  THE BATTERIES CONTAINED IN THE AFFECTED GPS UNITS CAN OVERHEAT.
